title: Preflight release security intake and evidence matrix
content:
Purpose:
This doc captures a lightweight, practical preflight intake for security reviews prior to any customer-impacting release. It ties checklist items to concrete automated evidence outputs (where available), specifies SIEM/exports to verify, and documents the exception approval path if a control cannot be met before launch. Use this as the canonical quick-gate for product, infra, and SRE engineers to get a release cleared from the security and compliance standpoint.

Scope:
- Applies to any release that touches RBAC (controls, role changes, permission matrices), audit logging schema, SIEM export formats, or the evidence automation pipeline used for compliance attestations (SOC-style evidence snapshots).
- Excludes: minor doc-only changes and non-customer-facing telemetry tweaks unless they modify the audit schema or export pipelines.

Quick decision checklist (pass/fail items):
1) RBAC v2 mapping verified: Are role -> permission mappings for the changed services available in the RBAC v2 declarative manifest? Evidence: generated rbac-v2-manifest.json in pipeline artifacts.
   - Test: run `scripts/validate-rbac.sh --manifest artifacts/rbac-v2-manifest.json` (CI job 1254). Expected: zero mismatches.
2) Audit log schema compatibility: Does the change preserve the audit log schema or include a documented migration? Evidence: audit-schema-diff.json and schema-forward-compat.txt.
   - Test: run `audit-schema-compare --base prod-schema.json --candidate artifacts/audit-schema.json` and confirm no removed required fields.
3) SIEM export sanity: Are the SIEM export topics/indices updated and backward-compatible? Evidence: siem-export-config.yaml and sample-export.ndjson.
   - Test: ingest sample-export.ndjson into staging Kibana index and confirm dashboards render.
4) Evidence automation: Have automated evidence artifacts been produced for this release? Evidence list: evidence-manifest.json, signed-evidence-bundle.tar.gz.
   - Test: CI job succeeded and artifacts are archived at the evidence job URL.
5) Alerting/monitoring hooks intact: Any changes to logging routes or cluster-level agents must preserve alert rules. Evidence: alert-rule-checksum.txt and AlertManager test webhook logs.
6) No privileged code path introduced without mitigations: New admin endpoints or escalation flows must include design review + mitigations. Evidence: design-review doc link and mitigations.txt.

Evidence matrix (control -> artifact -> validation step):
- RBAC v2 manifest -> artifacts/rbac-v2-manifest.json -> `validate-rbac.sh` exit 0.
- Audit schema -> artifacts/audit-schema.json + schema-diff report -> `audit-schema-compare` shows only additive changes.
- SIEM export -> artifacts/siem-export-sample.ndjson -> ingestion test in staging index (dashboard smoke).
- Evidence bundle -> signed-evidence-bundle.tar.gz -> signature verify (GPG) + artifact hash match.
- Permissions change PRs -> GitHub PR with at least two reviewers from infra/security team -> recorded in PR metadata.

RBAC v2 verification detailed steps:
1) Pull candidate manifest from CI artifacts.
2) Confirm every role change has an associated rationale comment in the manifest. Rationale should include: owner, risk summary, and runtime exposure (e.g., control-plane only vs. customer-facing API).
3) Run role simulation for top-5 critical roles (admin, billing-service, deployment-manager, storage-proxy, telemetry-reader) using `rbac-simulate` and compare allowed actions to a golden baseline.
4) If any new wildcard permissions (e.g., `*` or `all:read`) are introduced, escalate to security lead for exception.

Audit log schema checks:
- Required fields: timestamp, actor.id, actor.type, action, resource.id, resource.type, request_id, outcome. The schema comparator must flag any removal or renaming of these fields.
- New fields are allowed if optional and documented with examples.
- Include at least one example event per changed event type in artifacts.

SIEM export validation (smoke tests):
- Confirm NDJSON format, UTF-8 encoding, and newline-delimited JSON.
- Confirm each event contains the standard meta headers (team, service, env, app_version).
- Run `siem-ingest-smoke --index staging-release-<build>` and verify mapping creation and dashboard tile population within 2 minutes.

Exception approval process (when a control cannot be satisfied before launch):
- Triage and short-term risk: Owner files an exception request doc with the following fields: control, reason, estimated time-to-fix, compensating controls, rollback plan. Evidence required: risk-assessment.md and mitigation-test-results.txt.
- Rapid approval path: If the risk is low and compensating controls are complete, Security Lead + Product Manager can approve a time-boxed exception (max 30 days). Approval recorded as a single-line signed statement in exceptions-log.csv and linked PR.
- High-risk exceptions: Require Security Committee review (security lead, SRE lead, CTO) and must include explicit mitigation checkpoints enforced by CI (e.g., run extra audit sampling job nightly).
- Expiry and verification: Every exception must have an automatic calendar reminder and a follow-up verification artifact produced by the evidence pipeline before re-approval.

Sign-off block (fill in for final approval):
- Release tag: <RELEASE_TAG>
- Owner (engineer): ___________________ (name, email)
- Primary QA/SRE: ___________________
- Security Reviewer: ___________________
- Evidence artifacts URL: ___________________
- Exceptions attached: yes/no (link if yes)
- Sign-off timestamp: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC

Post-launch validation (first 72 hours):
- Confirm SIEM is receiving export events (count from baseline +/- 10%).
- Spot-check 20 audit events for required fields and correct actor mapping.
- Ensure no increase in alerting noise (define baseline alert count per team).
- Run nightly evidence snapshot job and confirm artifact creation.

Appendix A — Helpful commands and CI jobs:
- validate-rbac.sh --manifest artifacts/rbac-v2-manifest.json
- audit-schema-compare --base prod-schema.json --candidate artifacts/audit-schema.json --report artifacts/schema-diff.json
- siem-ingest-smoke --file artifacts/siem-export-sample.ndjson --index staging-release-<build>
- CI jobs: evidence-artifacts (https://ci.redwood.internal/job/evidence-artifacts/1254), rbac-validate (https://ci.redwood.internal/job/rbac-validate/212)

Appendix B — Minimum required reviewers for this gate:
- Security reviewer (must be from security-and-compliance team)
- Service owner (feature owner)
- SRE/infra on-call (for rollout monitoring)

Notes and rationale (freeform):
- This doc is intentionally short and focused on artifacts rather than committees. Wherever possible we rely on automation to produce verifiable evidence and keep human approvals for high-risk deviations only.
- If you are missing an artifact that the checklist requires, do not fudge the answer — open an exception request and document the compensating controls.

Draft history:
- 2024-11-05: initial draft by Aisha Patel
- 2024-12-02: added SIEM smoke test steps (Marcus Chen)
- 2025-01-10: refined exception approval timeline and added evidence artifact URLs (Lena Rodriguez)
